title: Hearing Aid Battery Cycle Test Coverage
dataSources: Mobility-aid status (`mobilityaid:status`), wheelchair battery telemetry (`wheelchair:battery`), stairlift service records (`stairlift:service`), hearing-aid battery records (`hearingaid:battery`), pendant-alert tests (`pendant:test`).
app: Wheelchair battery telemetry, stairlift service records, hearing-aid battery reminders, and pendant-alert test logs streamed to Splunk HEC via apps, service portals, and caregiver forms.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=hearingaid:battery
| stats sum(eval(if(test_result="pass",1,0))) as passed count as tests by device
| eval pass_pct=round(100*passed/tests,1)
| sort - pass_pct
description: Measures how consistently hearing aid battery cycle checks are being run and passing.
value: Regular testing matters because safety and mobility aids often look fine right up until they are not.
implementation: Write a simple `test_result=pass/fail` field whenever a manual or automatic test is recorded.
visualization: Table of devices with total tests and pass percentage.
grandmaExplanation: It reveals whether hearing aid battery cycle checks are happening regularly and passing cleanly.
